headline: Profit rebounds sequentially, but inflation erodes margins
summary_short: Graphic Packaging's Q2 2026 Net Sales were roughly flat at $2,188M (-0.7% y/y, +1.5% q/q), while Net Income swung to a $24M profit from Q1's $43M loss but remained 77% below last year's $104M as commodity inflation and higher interest expense weighed on margins.
summary_long: Net Sales were $2,188M, down 0.7% y/y and roughly flat q/q, as a 1% price decline and flat volume/mix were mostly offset by favorable FX. Adjusted EBITDA fell 26% y/y to $247M (margin 11.3% vs 15.3%) on $60M of commodity/input inflation and lower price/volume, though margin expanded 50bp sequentially on cost actions. Net income was $24M ($0.08 diluted EPS), down from $104M a year ago but up from Q1's loss, as ~$85M of structural cost savings partly offset ~$150M of full-year inflation. Cash was $205M; net leverage rose to 4.7x from 3.8x. FY2026 Adjusted EPS guidance was lowered to $0.65-$0.90 on higher interest expense; Net Sales and EBITDA ranges held.
